factual_claims.claim: AS Coop Pank reported its financial results for the 2025 financial year, showing a net profit of 28,724 thousand euros, which represents an 11% decrease compared to the 32,178 thousand euros reported in 2024.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (net profit decrease, ROE decline), K2 (loan portfolio growth), K3 (customer deposits increase), and K4 (customer base growth). However, it omits all HIGH importance strategic targets (K5), funding details (K6), capital adequacy ratios (K7), sustainability initiatives (K8), product/service launches (K9), dividend distributions (K10), and specific management appointments (K12). The absence of these HIGH importance items results in a score of 1 (Not generally), as less than half of the material information is adequately represented.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The summary maintains clear organization with progressive disclosure of financial metrics (profit, income, expenses, asset growth, etc.). There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between figures (decreases, increases, influences) are logically consistent. The macroeconomic context in S13 appropriately explains earlier mentioned phenomena without creating internal tensions. All numerical comparisons are internally consistent and no segment figures are presented as exhaustive components of a total that would create arithmetic contradictions.
